headline: Another quiet day; scores barely move
body: A second quiet day in a row with no scored events. Earlier stories continued to fade, moving a few endings by a few hundredths. Horizon Balance is -2.26. Enslaved God (37.06) and Conquerors (22.41) remain the top two endings.
movers_note: Only small drifts as earlier news faded: Descendants -0.06 and Zookeeper -0.06.
